# StyledByKeana

> Natural hair artistry by Keana Anjelica Mary in Berkeley, California. Protective styles (knotless and box singles, bohemian, Fulani, feed-ins, braided ponytails), invisible locs, twists, locs, the Deluxe Dukes Press silk press, cuts, color, men's braids and twists, and kids' braids (Keke Loves the Kids, 12 and under). Book on Booksy.

## Contact and location
- Address: 1518 San Pablo Avenue, Suite 3, Berkeley, CA 94702
- Phone: (415) 997-9107
- Booking: https://booksy.com/en-us/240113_styledbykeana_hair-salon_119583_berkeley

## Hours (as listed on Booksy)
- Wednesday, Thursday, Friday: 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM
- Saturday: 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM (some upcoming Saturdays are blocked; check Booksy)
- Sunday, Monday, Tuesday: closed

## About
- Owner and stylist: Keana Anjelica Mary (clients also call her Keke). Instagram bio: Natural Hair Artistry.
- Black-owned, women-owned, LGBTQ+ friendly (Google Business Profile attributes).
- Amenities (Booksy): parking, accessible, child-friendly, Wi-Fi.
- About, in Keana's words: StyledByKeana is a Bay Area-based salon experience rooted in intention, care, and transformation. We specialize in protective styles, precision cuts, natural hair care, and customized services for men, women, and children. Every crown is unique—and here, it’s treated like royalty. From wash day to silk presses, loc care to braid artistry, we create a space where you feel seen, celebrated, and styled with love.
- Mission: My mission as a stylist is to bring your vision to life with excellence, care, and consistency. Every service is done with purpose—to help you fall in love with your look, honor your crown, and leave feeling confident and restored.
- Vision: StyledByKeana will change the way you think and feel about your hair. We take time to educate you on your hair, products, and styling choices so you leave empowered, informed, and elevated.
- Core beliefs: Learning and growth; Trust and transparency; Creativity and care; Flexibility and professionalism.

## Reputation (checked 28 Sep 2026)
- Booksy: 4.9 stars from 190 reviews (186 five-star)
- Google: 5.0 stars from 33 reviews

## Policies
- Braiding hair is NOT provided. Bring your own, any type.
- 15-minute grace period. If running late, contact Keana 30 to 60 minutes ahead. More than 15 minutes late may be canceled or rescheduled with a fee.
- Same-day or day-off (typically Monday) booking fee: $75+.
- Early morning (before hours) appointment fee: $50+.
- Takedown is not included; book Take down separately ($75+, 45 min).
- Repeat clients can pre-book their next appointment before leaving.
